title: Expense Per Diem Rates by Travel Region
body:
Daily meal expense limits vary by travel destination:

HIGH-COST REGIONS ($100/day): - California (San Francisco, Los Angeles, San Diego) - New York City and surrounding areas - Boston, MA - Seattle, WA - Washington, DC

MEDIUM-COST REGIONS ($75/day): - Chicago, IL - Denver, CO - Atlanta, GA - Philadelphia, PA - Portland, OR

LOW-COST REGIONS ($50/day): - Texas (Houston, Dallas, Austin) - Arizona (Phoenix, Tucson) - Most other US states and cities

These limits apply to total daily meal expenses including breakfast, lunch, dinner, and incidentals. Expenses exceeding these limits require manager approval.

title: Travel Policy Compliance Reference
body:
ADVANCE BOOKING REQUIREMENTS: - Analyst/Consultant: 14+ days advance booking required - Manager/Senior Manager: 7+ days advance booking required - Partner: No advance booking requirement - Exception: Travel within 48 hours is considered urgent

FLIGHT CLASS ELIGIBILITY: - Analyst/Consultant: Economy class only - Manager/Senior Manager: Economy standard; Business class allowed for flights over 6 hours - Partner: Any class allowed

HOTEL RATE CAPS: - Analyst/Consultant: $200/night maximum - Manager/Senior Manager: $300/night maximum - Partner: No limit

TRIP DURATION: - Trips under 7 days: Standard approval - Trips 7 days and longer: Manager approval required

All exceptions to these policies require manager approval.

title: Hardware Eligibility and Device Policies
body:
LAPTOP REFRESH POLICY: - Eligibility: Laptops 36+ months old qualify for standard replacement - Early replacement (under 36 months): Requires manager approval and valid reason (physical damage, lost/stolen, critical performance issues) - Standard devices: Windows laptops (Dell Latitude, ThinkPad) - Non-standard devices: MacBook requires engagement code justification and manager approval

PHONE REPLACEMENT POLICY - BATTERY HEALTH: - 80% or below: Automatic replacement eligibility (no approval needed) - 81-90%: Borderline - manager approval required - 91% or above: Not eligible for battery-related replacement

PHONE REPLACEMENT POLICY - PHYSICAL DAMAGE: - Broken screen, water damage, or device lost/stolen: Manager approval required - Devices under 24 months: Manager approval required - Devices 24+ months: Automatic approval for damage-related replacement

PROCUREMENT LEAD TIMES: - Laptops: 18 days - Phones: 14 days - Other devices: 21 days

INVENTORY: - If device in stock at employee's office location: Ships within 1-2 business days - If not in stock: Procurement from vendor (2-3 week lead time)

title: Engagement Code Format and Lookup Guide
body:
ENGAGEMENT CODE FORMAT: - Format: ENG-####### (ENG- prefix followed by 7 digits) - Example: ENG-0012345

HOW TO FIND YOUR ENGAGEMENT CODE:

1. Via Salesforce: - Log into Salesforce - Navigate to 'My Engagements' tab - Engagement code appears in the 'Code' column

2. Via Mavenlink: - Access Mavenlink time tracking - View your assigned projects - Engagement code is listed in project details

3. Ask Your Engagement Manager: - Your engagement manager or senior manager always has the engagement code - Check your engagement welcome email

WHEN ENGAGEMENT CODE IS REQUIRED: - Software access requests (all specialized software) - Client system access - Non-standard laptop requests (MacBook) where engagement code is required as justification

If you cannot locate your engagement code, contact your engagement manager or reach out to internal support.
